segments.contextAfter: `applicationList`: An array of [`SecTrustedApplication`](sectrustedapplication.md) instances identifying apps that are allowed access to the keychain item without user confirmation. Use the [`SecTrustedApplicationCreateFromPath(_:_:)`](sectrustedapplicationcreatefrompath(_:_:).md) method to create trusted app objects. If you set this parameter to `nil`, then any app can use this item. If you pass an empty array, then no apps are trusted.
